messages:
pm-partners: Quick notes from the DeepBridge onboarding call. They want a marketplace 'download-only' quantized SKU + an optional SI-co-managed deploy. Need cross-team alignment.
danielle: Does download-only mean unrestricted binary distribution? Sounds risky re: rehosting.
viktor: Runtime POV: 4-bit/3-bit quant variants require our validated kernel set. If we expose downloads we should publish a signed container and a small shim that verifies checksum and runtime compatibility.
alana: Legal flagged two big things: (1) geoblocking & export controls, (2) a clause preventing public API rehosting by downstreams. They'll also ask for a provenance attestation about training data.
ravi: SI notes: we can support co-managed installs but require SSO + KMS integration and a telemetry schema (they want only aggregate perf). Need a clear opt-out path for enterprise buyers.
billing-bot: For marketplace downloads, marketplace will handle purchase transactions. We can map listing_id -> partner_id in exports so partners get their cut. For hosted inference rev-share, we can do per-inference reporting.
legal-bot: Draft clause suggestion: "Distributor shall not operate the Model or derivatives on publicly accessible hosted API endpoints; Distributor must implement geoblocking consistent with applicable export laws and maintain provenance and recipient records."
pm-partners: Action items captured:
- legal (alana) to draft commercial addendum + provenance attestation (due Tue)
- runtime (viktor) to prototype signed container + checksum shim (POC by next Wed)
- SI (ravi) to produce SSO/KMS/runbook + telemetry keys (due Thu)
- billing (billing-bot) to confirm partner_sku -> listing_id mapping (due Mon)
- marketing to propose embargo + logo usage SLA (pm to ask DeepBridge)

viktor: Also will add a small test matrix: quant kernel versions + sequence lengths to the playbook.
alana: Also recommend an indemnity carveout for misuse if DeepBridge allows downstream modifications. Add "no-derivative-public-hosting" clause.
pm-partners: Scheduling sync with DeepBridge + legal + eng + SI for next Fri 9am PT. I'll send invite and include the playbook link. :calendar: 
ops-bot: Playbook stub created: /playbooks/marketplace-deepbridge/onboard.md Link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/marketplace-deepbridge/onboard.md
pm-partners: Thanks all, please react with :white_check_mark: when you've added your deliverables to the playbook.
